notes: Airship gunnery organised around sightlines, cover and chokepoints against AI forces is Shooter, and the PvE Shooter preset matches the Helldivers-style staged-objective battles the author asked for; Simulation is second because the between-battle tech tree, research and component buying is a real progression loop even though it sits outside the battle space. The shape is volume-open-air rather than the preset's lane-network because the author said the fight is primarily in open sky with a small number of floating islands, cloud banks and structures as cover, chokepoints or objectives - islands are terrain in the map, not the map. I dropped the preset's building-interior since ship boarding is explicitly a future roadmap item, and added cover-los, spawn-teambase for the two forces starting a flight apart plus the team repair base, capture-zone for the capture-or-defend objectives, and island-cluster for the floating rocks and cities. CHECK is flagged deliberately: layered floating islands in a 3D sky volume are exactly the self-occlusion case, so I kept the island count small as stated and treated the compact battle space as one map serving both PvP skirmish and PvE war rather than separate maps.
